name: Still Joking
source: What do mirror reflections do once they have no one to repeat after anymore? Play as Iris, quite a sarcastic reflection torn between the urge to unravel the mystery of death of her “prototype” and the need to find her place in a mirrored world. (https://store.steampowered.com/app/2147330/Still_Joking/)
